2026_02_SEA_ARI.paragraph1: Seattle will start Drew Lock with Sam Darnold out because of a glute injury, and the Seahawks also enter Sunday with safety Ty Okada unavailable. 2026_02_WAS_DAL.headline: Washington’s slow-start problem meets a Dallas defense forced to replace two starters
2026_02_WAS_DAL.paragraph1: Washington and Dallas both arrive 0-1 in the NFC East, but the Commanders’ Week 1 offense did much of its damage late and has emphasized starting faster. Dallas is trying to repair its own opening performance without linebacker DeMarvion Overshown and safety Malik Hooker, both ruled out. Washington is also missing linebacker Frankie Luvu and tight end Chig Okonkwo. The Commanders can attack new defensive combinations; the Cowboys need Dak Prescott’s offense to prevent another early deficit.
